  • Method Details

    • phonePage

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/account/phone", produces="text/html") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> phonePage(@Size(max=40) @Valid @RequestParam(value="status",required=false) @Nullable @Size(max=40) @Valid String status)
      GET /account/phone : Renders the phone account page Renders the page where the signed-in user enrols, verifies and removes the phone number that receives one-time codes by SMS. It shows the verified phone, masked so that only its last digits are visible, or the form to enter a number; once a number was submitted it shows the form that asks for the code received by SMS. The forms post to POST /account/phone, POST /account/phone/verify and POST /account/phone/remove, with the CSRF token, and each answers by redirecting back here: the bearer-protected REST API (/api/account/phone) is for other clients, a browser page has a session, not a token. Like the passkeys page it needs a session that satisfies the multi-factor policy of the account. A request without a signed-in session is redirected to the sign-in page.
      Parameters:
      status - Outcome of the previous form post, so the page can tell it: pending (a code was sent, if the number can receive one), verified, removed, invalid-phone, country-not-allowed, invalid-code, rate-limited or step-up-required. Any other value is ignored. (optional)
      Returns:
      The phone page. (status code 200)

    • removePhonePage

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/account/phone/remove") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> removePhonePage()
      POST /account/phone/remove : Removes the phone number from the page Removes the verified phone and any pending verification (the same operation as DELETE /api/account/phone, for the session of a browser) and redirects to the page with status removed. While the account has a confirmed second factor the session must show a recent multi-factor sign-in, as the bearer token must for the REST API; otherwise nothing is removed and the redirect carries status step-up-required, which asks the user to sign in again.
      Returns:
      Redirects to the phone page, with the outcome in the status parameter. (status code 303)

    • startPhoneEnrolmentPage

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/account/phone", consumes="application/x-www-form-urlencoded") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> startPhoneEnrolmentPage(@Size(min=1,max=32) @Valid @RequestParam(value="phone",required=true) @Size(min=1,max=32) @Valid String phone)
      POST /account/phone : Starts the enrolment of a phone number from the page Sends a verification code by SMS to the number (the same operation as PUT /api/account/phone, for the session of a browser) and redirects to the page with status pending. The answer is the same whether or not the number already belongs to another account, so the page never reveals which numbers are registered. A number that is not valid or belongs to a country SMS messages are not sent to redirects with the status invalid-phone or country-not-allowed, and too many requests with rate-limited. While the account has a confirmed second factor (the new number would replace the verified one), the session must show a recent multi-factor sign-in, or the page is shown with the status step-up-required and nothing is sent.
      Parameters:
      phone - The phone number, in international format (+34 600 111 222) or in the national one of the default region. (required)
      Returns:
      Redirects to the phone page, with the outcome in the status parameter. (status code 303)

    • verifyPhonePage

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/account/phone/verify", consumes="application/x-www-form-urlencoded") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> verifyPhonePage(@Size(min=1,max=16) @Valid @RequestParam(value="code",required=true) @Size(min=1,max=16) @Valid String code)
      POST /account/phone/verify : Confirms the phone number from the page Confirms the number with the code received by SMS (the same operation as POST /api/account/phone/verify, for the session of a browser) and redirects to the page with status verified. A wrong or expired code redirects with status invalid-code and counts as an attempt; too many requests redirect with rate-limited.
      Parameters:
      code - The numeric code received by SMS. (required)
      Returns:
      Redirects to the phone page, with the outcome in the status parameter. (status code 303)
